input.summary: Use upper bumper action to complete GRANADA or numbers 1 through 10, switching to safe 5,000-point Shatz passes when the bumpers are weak.

quickInfo.name: GRANADA letters
quickInfo.summary: Completing the GRANADA letter lanes enables its center Special target and lights the left saucer for 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Number set
quickInfo.summary: Completing standups 1 through 10 enables its center Special target and lights the right saucer for 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Double award
quickInfo.summary: Completing both sets before the center Special can award two extra balls when the machine permits them.

quickInfo.name: Bumper dependency
quickInfo.summary: Most letters and numbered targets require upper bumper action because the flippers cannot shoot them directly.

quickInfo.name: Return lanes
quickInfo.summary: Each return lane scores 5,000 and can support repeated reverse-lane passes when its exit is safe.

quickInfo.name: Edition scope
quickInfo.summary: This route and image cover Williams Granada; Spanish Eyes is a related layout, not the same named edition.

steps.text: Confirm whether extra balls score or remain playable in the event.
Send the ball to the upper bumpers through the safest open route.
Nudge bumper action toward missing GRANADA lanes and numbered standups.
Track which of the two feature sets is nearer completion.
Complete that set and confirm its matching 5,000-point saucer lights.
If extra balls count, shoot the matching center Special target.
If extra balls do not count, continue upper scoring without forcing the center target.
Shatz pass through a safe return lane for 5,000 when upper action is weak.

fallback.title: Return-lane repeat
fallback.when: Use this plan when weak bumpers make letter and number progress too slow.

steps.text: Test one Shatz pass through a 5,000-point return lane.
Track the complete lane exit.
Repeat from the opposite flipper only when the exit reaches control.
Stop after any sling, outlane, or center-drain feed.
Return to upper play when a clean opportunity appears.

alternatives.title: Two-extra-ball collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan when extra balls remain playable and both feature sets are close to completion.

steps.text: Complete the remaining GRANADA letter.
Complete the remaining numbered target.
Confirm that both center Special indicators are active.
Shoot the center Special target for the combined award.
Choose GRANADA letters or numbers 1 through 10.
Use upper bumper action for the missing items.
Complete the chosen set.
Confirm that its 5,000-point saucer lights.
Collect the enabled center award only when the event gives it value.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Track each upper rebound. Nudge toward a missing letter lane or numbered target before the ball leaves the bumper area.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Shatz pass through the opposite return lane only when its exit settles safely.

techniques.name: Feature-set tracking
techniques.instruction: Read both progress sets after each upper sequence. Finish the nearer set instead of dividing attempts evenly.

cautions.issue: Weak bumpers can prevent most letters and numbers from registering during upper play.
cautions.response: Test bumper strength early. Switch to safe return-lane passes when feature progress remains poor.

cautions.issue: A reverse return-lane pass can feed a sling, outlane, or center drain on an unsafe unit.
cautions.response: Test one pass before repeating. Abandon the route after the first uncontrolled exit.

cautions.issue: The center Special target has little value when the event disables extra balls and gives no substitute award.
cautions.response: Confirm the event rule before play. Do not force the center target without a scoring benefit.

playfieldReferences.label: GRANADA lanes

playfieldReferences.description: Upper numbered standups whose completion lights the right saucer and its center Special.

playfieldReferences.label: Center Special targets
playfieldReferences.description: Two center targets used to collect one or two qualified added balls.

playfieldReferences.label: Left 5,000 saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Left hole lit for 5,000 by completing GRANADA.

playfieldReferences.label: Right 5,000 saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Right hole lit for 5,000 by completing 1–10.

playfieldReferences.label: 5,000 return lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Lower return lanes that can support a repeatable Shatz pass.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the Williams Granada playfield; do not transfer these rules to Spanish Eyes or a licensed copy with different switches.
Confirm ball count and whether added balls remain playable, are disabled, or receive a point substitute.
Test bumper strength, both 5,000 saucers, both return-lane exits, center targets, and tilt sensitivity before choosing upper play or Shatz passes.
input.simpleOverview: Granada uses upper bumper action to complete either G-R-A-N-A-D-A letters or numbered targets 1 through 10. Feed the upper playfield, follow bumper action toward the nearer set, then collect its lit 5,000-point saucer or use a safe return-lane Shatz pass when upper action is weak.
input.overview: In Granada, completing G-R-A-N-A-D-A lights the left 5,000 saucer and completing targets 1 through 10 lights the right 5,000 saucer. Work the nearer set through bumper action, collect its saucer when safe, and use 5,000-point return lanes as the controlled fallback. Do not force the center target when its configured extra-ball award has no value.
